decision.reasoning_trace: I started by filtering out the numerous accessories and replacement parts (cases, chargers, batteries) that were listed alongside the actual speakers. From the remaining options, I selected five speakers that offered a mix of brand reliability, unique design, and high performance specs. The JBL Go 3 (prod_009) was considered for brand reputation, while the INSMY Retro (prod_049) was chosen for its wood aesthetic. Ultimately, the Raymate (prod_153) was the best value choice, offering 30W output power and IPX7 waterproofing with a high 4.6 rating for only $39.99, outperforming the similar NOTABRICK model (prod_168) in terms of power-to-price ratio.
